messages:
deploy-bot: initiating rollout: release/2025.08.11 -> prod. feature flag `llmroute_v4` toggled to CANARY (pinned binary: v4.0.0). change-window 23:30-01:30 UTC. cc @anya @frank for ramp coordination.

frank: ack. proposed ramp: 1% -> 4% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. hold at each step. soak durations 8m/12m/20m/30m. health gates = 5xx < 0.25%, p95 delta < +100ms, quality check pass.

anya: add auto-safety: if p95 delta > +150ms for 5m OR 5xx > 0.7% for 3m then auto-mute and pin-back. rollback command in playbook: `deploy-bot revert-flag llmroute_v4 && deploy-bot pin-service v3.8.4`. Lina pls confirm alerts.

lina: alerts set (p95, 5xx, OOM, model-memory). added synthetic job (n=200 every 5m) to validate completion correctness.

sam: release notes posted: https://redwood.internal/releases/2025-08-11-llmroute-v4. includes ramp table and exact revert command. also added prefetch step to warm model caches before each bump.

deploy-bot: dry-run OK. reserving 8 canary hosts and toggling flag now.
```
[2025-08-11T23:31:02Z] build passed
[2025-08-11T23:32:20Z] canary deploy (hosts=8) started
[2025-08-11T23:34:00Z] flag llmroute_v4 set to 1% (cohort=canary)
```

frank: canary live. starting 8m soak. monitors: @lina @anya.

[5m later]
frank: seeing small p95 bump +45ms, synthetic pass rate 99.4%. holding until soak complete.

lina: noticed one host with repeated model-load spikes. issuing `model-warm` on host-03; memory stabilized.

[after soak]
frank: metrics stable. promoting to 4%.

deploy-bot: flag llmroute_v4=4%. logs: `quality-check job started (n=200)`

anya: at 4% we see slightly higher router retries but 5xx still <0.2%. proceed to 15% after configured soak.

[during 15% soak]
lina: small transient 5xx burst (0.45%) tied to a downstream auth cache TTL. increased cache timeout; 5xx dropped. no revert.

frank: hold extended 10m for confidence. reminder: if we hit auto-mute thresholds, deploy-bot will flip flag off and pin to v3.8.4, but manual rollback still preferred for context.

[safe to continue]
frank: proceeding to 50% -> full. leaving final 30m soak at 50% before 100%. assigning follow-ups: @sam update relnotes with incident note about cache TTL, @anya verify post-roll metrics next day.

deploy-bot: rollout complete to 100% at 00:42 UTC. final heartbeat: healthy hosts=120, error_rate=0.09%, p95_delta=+52ms, synthetic_fail=0.7%.

anya: thanks everyone. added the exact pin-back and revert commands to the release notes and ops playbook. end thread.
